title: Continuation Pass Two — Gevurah Critique
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Continuation Pass Two — Gevurah Critique The Awtsmoos pours infinite possibility through vessels that must remain exact; Awtsmoos.com grows stronger when every claimed feature survives a deterministic fact. Critique of the current unification 1. Capability declarations are not sufficient
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he continuation pass two — gevurah critique the awtsmoos pours infinite possibility through vessels that must remain exact; awtsmoos.com grows stronger when every claimed feature survives a deterministic fact. critique of the current unification 1. capability declarations are not sufficient proof; each advertised semantic kind must survive compile, normalize, bridge, evaluate, and render paths. 2. default ai scenes already contain rich 2d/3d vocabulary, so duplicating another renderer would increase drift rather than capability. 3. dimension resolution is currently a semantic leak and must be repaired before trusting arbitrary ai scenes. 4. shared→core→shared proof currently checks duration and scene count only; representative feature preservation needs stronger assertions. 5. a 180 second project is not a rendered movie until the export pipeline emits a media file and the media probe confirms duration/streams. 6. mobile first means browser evidence at a narrow viewport with usable controls, not only responsive css declarations. 7. concurrent studio work makes broad rewrites dangerous; this pass should improve shared contracts and tests first, then integrate only proven gaps. thirty improvements to enforce 1. preserve resolved scene dimension. 2. pass resolved dimension to entity mapping. 3. insert spatial world/light from resolved dimension. 4. regression test omitted dimension. 5. regression test explicit 2d. 6. regression test explicit 3d. 7. assert character kind by dimension. 8. assert particle kind by dimension. 9. assert shape/model kind by dimension. 10. assert normalized scene keeps dimension. 11. validate compiled movie after normalization. 12. check 180 second exact duration. 13. check scene count and boundary coverage. 14. check both 2d and 3d modes. 15. check multiple camera kinds. 16. check reusable actors. 17. check charts/tutorial overlays. 18. check text layers and keyframes. 19. check particle layers. 20. check transitions. 21. check shared/core bridge preservation. 22. check deterministic seek at boundaries. 23. check final second evaluation. 24. check browser console. 25. check desktop viewport. 26. check mobile viewport. 27. check touch sized controls. 28. check export command produces an actual file. 29. probe actual media duration/streams. 30. re read every touched file and compare plan versus actual. ownership discipline prefer new focused tests and small shared modules. do not rewrite concurrently modified studio surfaces unless an integration failure proves it is necessary and the file is freshly re read immediately before the whole file rewrite.
